reference_article.title: Improving scalability of multi-agent deep reinforcement learning with suboptimal human knowledge
reference_article.analysis: Introduction moves from a practical difficulty to gaps in existing work, the chosen intervention and three empirically supported findings; related work precedes formalization and experiments; conclusion limits the interpretation. Adopted this explanatory order and end-of-article author information. Human-knowledge transfer and scalability findings are not evidence for our communication study.
reference_article.use: structural and layout reference only; not added as an unrelated scientific citation

guideline.rule: Title page must identify authors, affiliations and corresponding author with active email. Exact template contact wording is not required.
guideline.implementation: Requested reading manuscript has names and Abstract first, full details last. Separate Title_Page.pdf supplies title-page metadata; journal acceptance of the requested placement is not asserted.
